provenanceNote: Starting hypotheses written from public provider documentation and community experience — not benchmarked claims. PromptLoop refines these through your feedback, in your browser.

fields.instruction_style: Terse imperative works well; markdown headers give useful structure
fields.reasoning_trigger: Benefits from an explicit 'reason through this before answering' on multi-step tasks
fields.format_adherence: High with an explicit template or schema; drifts on loose prose formats
fields.verbosity_bias: Mirrors prompt length — short prompts get short answers
fields.role_sensitivity: Moderate; a concrete role beats an elaborate persona
fields.context_placement: Front-load the objective; recall of mid-context details degrades in long prompts

house_rules.text: Give an explicit output template or example of the desired shape
Number multi-part requirements so none get merged
Repeat the single most critical constraint at the end of the prompt

failure_modes: Invents its own structure when no format is specified
Compresses below requested detail on long outputs
